question: How do weighted missing-field bounds and bounded recorded-field reassignment alter the frozen Sunset accounting claims?
baseline: Stages 11U and 11V: the selected nonblank population has a 52.413% combined-byte Sunset share, and full-cohort exposure-field completion has a 20.418%-75.546% range when nonblank fields are fixed.
treatment: Retain the same source-exposure keys, representation inventory, target fields and byte weights. Calculate sharp weighted completion and at-most-r recorded-field membership-reassignment bounds, construct the minimum-cardinality tagged-byte majority witness, and compute equal-field-cost worst-case completion budgets.

assumptions.blank_membership: unconstrained binary membership for one target value
assumptions.recorded_membership: fixed at r=0; at most r binary target memberships may be reassigned in each separate sensitivity extremum
assumptions.selection: original nonblank query frozen; a reassigned recorded field stays nonblank
assumptions.weights: positive fixed integer archive-accounting weights, not scientific value or exposure time
assumptions.resolution_cost: one unit per individual field; real viewing, adjudication, retrieval and support costs unknown
assumptions.grouping: original frozen filename/order-conditioned capture keys; physical identity unvalidated

oracle: Source integrity and three-representation parity; exact baseline recovery; constructive completion/reassignment witnesses; integer strict-majority predecessor crossing; integer width-budget predecessor crossing; exhaustive small-model enumeration; implementation-diverse native recount; unchanged prior receipts.
claim_ceiling: Exact deterministic metadata-accounting sensitivity under the declared membership, fixed selection/weight and equal-field-cost assumptions. Reassignment budgets are hypothetical, not measured error rates. Completion bounds are marginal metadata-membership intervals, not a joint multiclass completion or physical truth. No actual audit, new pixels, physical capture merge, NASA pipeline finding, scientific discovery or acceptance.
stop: Reject source drift, incomplete/duplicate representation rows, inconsistent capture fields, invalid weights/budgets, failed predecessor or witness replay. Do not acquire pixels, infer real label errors, or recommend a statistical audit size from these budgets.
recheck_trigger: A changed source snapshot, accepted native identity, qualified content-label oracle, measured tag-error evidence, explicit task estimand or real heterogeneous review costs.
authority: Private local analysis and local Git custody only. No outreach, repository remote, push, public release or new acquisition.
